author: John Hammond
description:
I was digging through Telegram activity in Flare and searching for the PCP.sh username to see what showed up across the history of those chats.

A couple of results were referencing a .EXE, and one of the accounts had the same Steam profile picture we'd already seen elsewhere in the investigation. That's another pretty high-confidence piece of the puzzle.

Full video: https://youtu.be/nj9e2Qfe3Cc?si=cLcEZFbj75Rqa7R1
title: Tracking TeamPCP Telegram
